steps.caption: An approved email to Priya Nair. The progress bar shows it is Ready.
Confirm the recipient and the text.
Check & open shows buttons to open your own mail app. Send it from there.
Back in CRE OS, press I sent it.
The message is now marked Sent.
Same conversation: the follow-ups are already planned, with dates.
A follow-up is only drafted when you ask, and pauses itself if they reply.
Activity records every step — drafted, approved, opened, sent — with times.
When they answer, paste it under 'Did they reply?'.
